description: EAGLE-I Power Outage Data 2024 is a data set deposited in DOE Oak Ridge National Laboratory (ORNL) Repository by its authors Varisara Tansakul, Aaron Myers. The provided EAGLE-I historic dataset includes power outage information at the county level for 2024 at 15-minute intervals collected by the EAGLE-I program at ORNL. The data has been collected from utility's public outage maps using an ETL process. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The repository holds 3 deposits of this kind (versions, parts or per-site or per-year releases); this record describes the series through its most recent member and lists the others in the notes. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is not stated (no licence in the DataCite metadata read on 2026-09-29). Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
